summary: The filing is a preliminary prospectus supplement for the issuance of First Mortgage Bonds by Duke Energy Progress, LLC under Rule 424(b)(5). This is a routine debt offering of two new series of mortgage bonds due in 2036 and 2056, with proceeds to the company and no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. Terms, interest rates, and offering amounts are left blank (preliminary). The bonds are secured by a mortgage lien and are not listed on any exchange. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
